in_use_evidence: No code at 9bb3a27 names folder_run, FolderRun or a Folder model, and no backlog story covers Folder Runs; the Folder stories are not cut yet.

rule_gap: The rulebook sends a defect in an architecture document to the document class and a threat to a quality scenario to the architecture class, but does not say which wins when the missing lock is both; gigacron has no arc42 chapter 10 (the scenarios sit unranked in the handoff), so the architecture matrix could not give an importance anyway.
